plainLanguage: Forney uses the 2021 International Residential Code with North Texas (NCTCOG) and local amendments, and the 2020 National Electrical Code, in force since January 2023. New neighborhoods are almost all planned developments (PDs), so your PD ordinance and plat set the setbacks; our defaults are placeholders until you confirm. The city asks for engineer-stamped structural plans and an engineer's foundation letter with every new-home permit, because of expansive clay soils. You also submit an energy compliance report under the 2021 energy code. We could not find Forney's permit fee or impact fee amounts, so those lines are left open. Texas law stops the city requiring brick, but your HOA likely will.
